title: Modular design
text: A design that is split into many different parts or "modules." Many different things such as electronic devices, cars, or other complex things could be one piece but it is much simpler to split it into many different pieces. The advantages of this are that cost can be reduced and it may be easier for separate things to accomplish their goals better. In math many things such as theorems, axioms, and conjectures are made up of many different parts that work together, most of our world is build this way.
